hints.title: Character Value Mapping
hints.text: Map each character to its assigned cost in chars/vals if overridden, or to its natural alphabetical index (1 to 26) otherwise.

hints.title: Maximum Subarray Sum
hints.text: Finding the substring of maximum cost is equivalent to the maximum contiguous subarray sum problem.

hints.title: Non-Negative Floor
hints.text: Because an empty substring has cost 0, the maximum answer is at least 0.

hints.title: Kadane Maximum Substring Cost Implementation

variables: m: number of overridden characters in chars
complexity.notes: Building lookup table takes O(m); single Kadane pass takes O(n).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all substrings takes O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(26) hash map for custom character costs.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies Kadane's maximum subarray algorithm with customized weights.
